caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate toppings: chashu, nori, menma, and a halved soft-boiled egg. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface texture.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly translucent pieces with a soft, fibrous texture.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, creamy white, and a smooth, slightly glossy surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
